Files and readings you asked me to confirm (all in `experiment-repo` `main`, `results/`; schema in `RESULTS_SCHEMA.md`, to be extended with the items below).
  > 
  > - **Primary n = 100.** Secondary n/N = 2 % in `results/twopct/` (n labelled 0; actual n = round(0.02·N), column `n_actual`); three main splits only.
  > - **Class representatives chosen without the held-out benchmark:** `results/selected.csv` and `results/twopct/selected.csv`. Rows with `held_out = ALL` are the leave-one-benchmark-out pooled geometric means (the number to plot as "selected"); `held_out = POSTHOC` is the same class with the representative chosen on all benchmarks (label it post hoc); a benchmark name = the choice made for that held-out benchmark (single-benchmark ratio, no interval). `primary_suite.csv` (+ `twopct/`) gives the same by suite (`all`, `OLL`, `HELM`).
  > - **Source count (Fig. for C4b):** `results/msrc.csv`; M = 0 is all sources.
  > - **Larger-gap inner split:** `results/inner50/` (same schema as the main results). **Stronger anchor k-means:** `results/kmstrong.csv`.
  > - **Fig. 3/6 bands:** `bias_bands.csv`, `pairwise_bands.csv` bin the targets by true-score position within benchmark and split (see the header of `scripts/05_bands.py` for the bin edges); the bias is signed (estimate − truth), averaged over draws then over targets in the band, ratios are geometric means over benchmarks.
  > - **Per-target bias:** `bias2_unbiased` and `n_draws` in `per_bench.csv.gz` (n = 100). A higher-R run (R = 100 at n = 100) is queued; I will tell you if the per-target values change (the committed ones use R = 10 / 40 with the MC-variance correction).
  > - **Regenerated:** extrap50 now includes legalbench (13 benchmarks); interp/lineage bootstrap endpoints moved ≤ 0.016, point estimates did not change. Please redraw from the current files; `twopct/primary.csv` was empty before and is fixed.
  > - **Wording to correct in captions:** anchor and info-top are not worse than uniform in interp/lineage at n = 100 (anchor|irt-plugin 0.95 [0.89,1.00] interp, 1.03 [0.93,1.09] lineage; infotop|calreg 1.11 [0.99,1.17] interp); they are clearly worse only in the extrapolation splits.
  > - **LOBO vs post-hoc:** in extrap at n = 100 the selected difference-corrected class is 0.87 [0.84,0.89] vs uniform and 1.03 vs strat; post hoc 0.82 and 0.96. Plot both and label which is which; `balanced|calreg` (0.77 / 0.91 vs strat) is the class that survives selection.
  > - Fall-back rates and the target-recalibrated estimator grid (`recal-*`, `irtw-*`) are still being computed; their files will come with a separate note.
